facts.text: Jimbaran Puri is a beach resort in Bali that combines tradition, culture and nature.
facts.excerpt: The perfect combination of tradition, culture and nature are the soul of the resort, creating a serene authentic Balinese beach hideaway.

facts.text: The resort has four open-air Hindu temples for worship: Telega, Surya, Baruna and Guardian.
facts.excerpt: Open-air Telega, Surya, Baruna and Guardian temples for worship

facts.text: Accommodation includes cottage suites, pool villas and deluxe pool villas.
facts.excerpt: selection of luxury cottages and spacious pool villas at Jimbaran Puri. Each accommodation offers a deep connection to the surrounding nature, with their rich teak wood detailing and airy cotton upholstery.

facts.text: Rooms feature teak wood detailing and cotton upholstery.
facts.excerpt: with their rich teak wood detailing and airy cotton upholstery.

facts.text: Nelayan is a restaurant with views of Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: Dine with tranquil views of Jimbaran Bay at Nelayan or relax over a candlelit feast for two.

facts.text: The resort has two destination restaurants, Nelayan and Tunjung, and the Puri beach bar.
facts.excerpt: Two destination restaurants, Nelayan and Tunjung

facts.text: Romantic dinners for two and private BBQ grill experiences are offered.
facts.excerpt: Romantic dinners for two and private BBQ grill experiences

facts.text: In-room dining is available upon request.
The resort has an infinity pool and a children's pool.
The hotel spa has views of Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: With stunning views of Jimbaran Bay, the hotel spa echoes the island’s tranquil ambience

facts.text: The resort has a luxury boutique.
The resort hosts intimate weddings, with beach, garden and indoor venues.
facts.excerpt: Beach, gardens and indoor venues for up to 90 guests

facts.text: The resort is located between the jungle and the beach on Jimbaran Bay.
facts.excerpt: With its privileged location between the jungle and beach

facts.text: The resort is 7km from Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS).
Ubud is a 1 hour 30 minutes drive from the resort.
